messages.subject: an expert pair of eyes to look at my code and results
parts:
I am doing my first SEM work and think that I finally have a model that works. This is based on Griffin et al 1999; 2004 Risk Information Seeking and Processing model. I have been working solo on this and have a limited background in statistics so any comments would be great! Thank you! My code and output:

model <- '
TrustGrp =~ GrpEffic_Select + GrpEffic_Rsc
PerceivedProb =~ PersLikelyCaught + PersLikelyDamage + PersLikelyInjury + PersLikelyKilled
SelfEff =~ PersConfAssess + PersConfTalkOut + PersConfWatch
PersonalCntrl =~ Group_LocusTrigger + Group_LocusCaught + Group_LocusSurviving
SubjNorms =~ SubN_FamCourseBel + SubN_FamInfoBel + SubN_PartCourseBel + SubN_PartInfoBel + SubN_FamMotConf + SubN_PartMotConf
Worry =~ WorryTrigger + WorryBuried + WorryInjured + WorryBuried
CurrentInfo =~ PersAv_CourseCurrKnowl
Threshold =~ PersAv_CourseSuffThresh


SubjNorms ~ SelfEff + IndChar_YrsOfRiding + IndChar_AgeCat 
Worry ~  TrustGrp + PerceivedProb + PersonalCntrl

CurrentInfo ~ SelfEff + IndChar_YrsOfRiding + IndChar_AgeCat
Threshold ~ Worry + SubjNorms + CurrentInfo
'
#To fit the model:
fit <- sem(model, data=TblInput, missing = "listwise", estimator = "MLM")
#To view the resutls
summary (fit, standardized=T, fit.measures=T, rsq=T)
